actions.text: No form pool yet — 'transformed' is modelled as a generic CR-5 borrowed body: a big temp-HP buffer (the borrowed bulk), +1 AC, a light damage soak, and predator's advantage on its Claws. It grants the bonus psychic damage on Grudge (below), Impeccable Discernment, and — via its 5 charges (regain all on a long rest) — Stolen Illusion and What Is Truth.

Each creature within 25 ft. must make a DC 18 Charisma save or (on a fail) can't knowingly speak a lie (if truth was chosen) or the truth (if lies was chosen) for 1 hour; Indri knows who passed or failed, and a creature that fails doesn't know the effect is on it until it tries to speak. Interrogation tool, not auto-resolved (no in-engine 'compelled honesty' condition).

actions.text: Mendax, 2 charges. Choose truth or lies; each creature within 25 ft., DC 18 Cha or can't knowingly speak a lie / the truth (whichever Indri chose) for 1 hour. Indri knows who succeeded or failed; a creature that fails isn't aware of the effect until it starts speaking.

actions.name: Stolen Illusion

automation.text: Mendax, 1 charge (automated default — see below for the manual option). When Indri sees a creature cast a spell that creates an illusion, the caster makes a DC 16 save using ITS OWN spellcasting modifier (not Indri's spell DC). On a failure, Indri gains control of the illusion (must begin concentrating on it if it requires concentration); while controlled it uses Animated Armor's statistics but still looks like whatever it originally did. The original caster doesn't immediately know control was lost. Not auto-resolved — no per-caster variable-DC save exists in the engine, and this is reactive/situational rather than a damage/control effect.

actions.text: Mendax, 1+ charges. Trigger: Indri sees a creature cast an illusion spell. The caster saves (DC 16, using its own spellcasting modifier) or Indri seizes the illusion, which then uses Animated Armor's stats while still looking like the original. Indri may spend additional charges (+4 DC each) for a tougher save — a player/DM choice, not automated. Mostly a campaign / Tiyanak-duel tool.

On a failed save, the target perceives everything it sees or hears as hilariously funny and is incapacitated for 1 minute. The target can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. (Humanoid/Int gate not modelled — applies to any target, which covers PCs.)

actions.text: The clown veils itself and everything it is wearing and carrying in an illusion that makes it look like some other creature of its size or smaller (such as a child) or an object small enough to fit in the clown's space (such as a floating balloon). Maintaining this effect requires the clown's concentration (as if concentrating on a spell), and the illusion fails to hold up to physical inspection. As an action, a creature that can see the clown's illusory form can make a DC 15 Wisdom (Insight) check, piercing the illusion and discerning the clown's true form on a success.

traits.name: Bloodied Breath

The ground in the area becomes difficult terrain, dealing 3 (1d6) fire damage to a creature that ends its turn there, for 3 rounds.

actions.name: Stoke Malice

automation.text: Move up to 15 ft without provoking, then:

automation.text: Pyrrha's Spawn ends the Burning condition on a creature within 15 feet of them. If they do, they roll to recharge Slagflame Breath.

automation.text: Then Pyrrha's Spawn flies up to half their speed.

automation.text: Fierce, hot wind radiates from Pyrrha's Spawn until initiative count 20 on the next round. Until then, flying creatures' flying speed is halved. At initiative count 20, each creature airborne in the area that isn't immune to fire damage takes 5 (1d10) fire damage.
